convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for RVI_Histogram custom indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position management, money management, and trade execution logic.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of the indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warmup

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of existing position via BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose when BuyPosClose/SellPosClose inputs are true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE=fraction of margin/balance (MM parameter interpreted as percentage fraction). Positive MM=fraction mode, fixed lot when LOT mode selected.

custom_logic_notes: Two distinct trend detection modes: (1) Levels mode - uses buffer 4 (color histogram) where Col[1]==0 means bullish zone (Col[0]>0 triggers buy), Col[1]==2 means bearish zone (Col[0]<2 triggers sell). (2) Cross mode (default) - uses buffers 0 (Up/RVI) and 1 (Dn/Signal) where Up>Dn on prior bar and Up<=Dn on earlier bar triggers buy crossover, and vice versa for sell. SignalBar input (default=1) controls which bar is used for signal detection - bar[1] means previous completed bar. When SignalBar==0, signals are evaluated on every tick without new-bar guard. Recount flag triggers re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. Close signals are generated simultaneously with opposite entry signals when the respective BuyPosClose/SellPosClose flags are enabled. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec for trade management by the TradeAlgorithms library.
python_conversion_notes: The RVI_Histogram custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The standard MT5 iRVI exists but RVI_Histogram is a custom variant with additional histogram coloring buffers (buffer 4 for color zones). The Levels mode depends on buffer 4 which is a color index (0=bullish, 2=bearish), not a standard RVI output. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, and GlobalVariableDel_ - all must be reimplemented. The money management logic (MarginMode enum: FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE, LOT) needs careful porting as it controls lot sizing based on account equity/balance metrics. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) - verify if TradeAlgorithms.mqh handles this internally. Signal timing (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) is passed to trade functions and may control order expiration or identification.
